title: Fix food spawning on top of the snake
body: The food can currently appear on a cell already occupied by the snake body. Update the spawn logic so food always appears on an empty cell only.

title: Add pause and resume controls
body: Add a pause/resume button and support the Space key as a keyboard shortcut. Keep the current Start / Play Again flow intact.

title: Support WASD controls
body: Players should be able to control the snake with W A S D in addition to the arrow keys.

title: Make the game board responsive on small screens
body: The current board overflows on smaller laptops and phones. Make the layout responsive while keeping the game playable and visually centered.

title: Persist the high score in localStorage
body: Track the highest score reached across sessions and save it to localStorage. Display the high score near the current score.

title: Extract gameplay constants into a config module
body: Move hard-coded gameplay constants such as grid size, cell size, and initial speed out of the main component into a dedicated config module.
